title: Quickstart Templates Sprint Huddle - Field Notes
content:
Attendees: Asha (chair), Marcus, Lina, Samir, Emily (UX), Dan (docs reviewer)

Purpose: quick sync to align on the Quickstart Templates sprint — shipping a small, copyable starter set for Node/Python/Go, and 3 sample apps (chat, embeddings search, reranker) with minimal infra requirements. Aim: ship beta quickstarts that work with hosted API and give clear upgrade path to Dedicated/Private.

Quick wins (what shipped since last huddle):
- baseline Node and Python quickstart templates scaffolded (folder structure, example .env, README shell) — PR-342 landed but needs final microcopy polish.
- embeddings sample (lightweight retriever) completed with sample corpus (500 docs) and docker-lite runner.
- created a tiny troubleshooting FAQ (common auth errors + token rotation snippet).

Focus for next 5 days:
1) Docs microcopy pass (Lina + Dan) — consistent tone, simplify auth section, explicit differences for Dedicated & Private.
2) Add robust examples for prompt templates + safety guardrails (Asha) — short checklist for customer-facing prompts.
3) Create a 'scaffold CLI' MVP that copies templates and prompts (Marcus) — CLI should accept model preset, region, and sample type.
4) Produce three short screencast snippets (60-90s) for onboarding page — Emily/Samir.

Decisions made: 
- Default quickstart will target hosted API v2 tokens and stream mode off to keep latency deterministic for new users.
- Use a single repository (sdk-quickstarts) with subfolders per language to make discoverability easier.
- Include an optional small Dockerfile that uses alpine + pip/apt minimal deps; no GPU support in beta.

Action items (owner / due / notes):
- Lina: microcopy pass for READMEs and auth section / due 2026-07-14 / annotate where Dedicated/Private diverge (ticket XS-821).
- Marcus: scaffold-cli alpha to create a template copy in workspace / due 2026-07-16 / feature flags for "include-samples".
- Asha: prompt safety checklist and example prompts for reranker and chat / due 2026-07-15 / include golden test cases for eval.
- Samir: record 3 onboarding screencasts + upload to bucket / due 2026-07-18 / get rough cuts to Emily for thumbnails.
- Dan: review code samples for style and SODA (security, observability, docs, accessibility) / due 2026-07-15 / focus on credentials examples.

Blockers & risks:
- Credential rotation example is still fuzzy for Private deploys behind KMS; need infra consult (ticket INF-573).
- Node samples use fetch API that breaks older Node LTS; must pin minimal node version and add note.
- Legal requested a short section about PII handling in sample datasets — blocks public sample corpus until wording is finalized (legal@redwood).

Notes & small threads: 
- Sample corpus: we used synthetic 'bio-sample' dataset to avoid PII; still needs legal signoff. Consider renaming to 'micro-faq-corpus' if legal prefers.
- Embeddings sample: add a note on index-size optimization, show `hf/emb-1024-quantized` as suggestion for low-cost runs.
- Telemetry: add one line in README showing how to enable debugging headers for Console traces (single ENV var).

Microcopy nits (quick fixes):
- README: replace "API key" with "Redwood API key (export REDWOOD_API_KEY)" to reduce confusion.
- Error handling: add clear sample for 401 -> suggest token refresh flow.
- Quickstart checklist in README should be a one-line command to run happy-path (ex: `npm run quickstart --example chat`).

Testing & QA plan:
- Golden prompts: create 6 short asserts for chat and 4 for reranker (Asha).
- CI: add lightweight smoke step that runs `node quickstart/chat/run.js` and `python -m quickstart.embeddings.run` in matrix with small timeouts.
- Coverage: aim for sample code to run in <60s on GH runners (no network heavy ops).

Open questions (for next meeting):
- Do we include a prebuilt sample index (hosted) for quick demos, or require local indexing? (tradeoffs: convenience vs cost & data ownership).
- How do we show Dedicated vs Hosted performance differences without publishing sensitive numbers? Suggest a qualitative note and link to private benchmark deck.

Misc:
- Suggested PR tags: quickstart, onboarding, samples.
- Plug: Emphasize "move from sample -> production" section that explains caching, batching, and model pinning. This fits product messaging around production-first developer experience.

Next sync: 2026-07-19 10:00 AM PT. Short 30m huddle, keep blockers prioritized.

Raw scratch: 
- CLI args: --language {node,python,go} --app {chat,embeddings,reranker} --include-samples true|false
- Example golden prompt (chat): "You are a concise assistant. Given the user query, produce a single helpful paragraph and list next steps."

End of notes.
